name: Laser Tattoo Removal
title: Laser Tattoo Removal in Tustin | OC Concierge Doctor
description: Laser tattoo removal in Tustin with Tariq A. Khan, MD. Typically 5 to 15 treatments spaced 6 to 12 weeks apart to fade or remove unwanted tattoos.
lede: Laser tattoo removal breaks tattoo ink into tiny particles that your body clears away over time. Most tattoos take 5 to 15 treatments, spaced 6 to 12 weeks apart.
glance: A planned series of laser sessions that fade ink a little more each time.

signs.heading: Good for
signs.intro: Removal works for full removal or for lightening a tattoo before a cover-up.
items: Fading a tattoo before a cover-up

basics.heading: Why it takes time
paras: Each laser session shatters some of the ink into particles small enough for your immune system to carry away. That clearing happens between visits, which is why treatments are spaced 6 to 12 weeks apart.
The number of sessions depends on the tattoo's size, colors, depth and age, and on where it is on your body. Dr. Khan gives you a realistic estimate before you start.

steps.heading: Your treatment plan
items: Dr. Khan assesses the tattoo and estimates the number of sessions.
Short laser treatments spaced 6 to 12 weeks apart.
The tattoo lightens after each session until your goal is met.

faq: Many patients compare it to getting the tattoo. Sessions are short.
Dark inks usually respond best. Some colors take more sessions. Dr. Khan will tell you what to expect for your tattoo.
